provenance.paper_title: MuKV: Multi-Granular Key-Value Cache for Efficient Long Video Understanding

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: An offline multi-grained KV cache is queried through semi-hierarchical retrieval.
During operation, MuKV applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to offline multigranular visual KV cache; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, MuKV applies merging or deduplication of overlapping entries to offline multigranular visual KV cache; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, MuKV applies explicit deletion or eviction of stored items to offline multigranular visual KV cache; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 5): Streaming inference builds and prunes multimodal KV caches; carried cache state is deliberately updated and reused, so this is T2. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
